description: Machine-readable manifest of all Hessa Design System components for AI-assisted development.

components.name: DsButtonComponent
components.intent: Primary call-to-action, form submission, and navigation trigger
components.notes: Button label must be provided via ng-content. The title input is a secondary/accessibility hint only. No (click) output — consume native (click) on the host element.
components.studentThemeNotes: All sizes add border-b bottom border for 3D press effect (sm/md: border-b-[4px], lg: border-b-[6px]). Active state compensates padding to prevent layout shift.
components.rtlNotes: Icon direction mirrors automatically via DsIconComponent
do: Use variant=primary for the single main CTA per view
Provide label text via ng-content
Use fullWidth=true for mobile stacked layouts
Use size=md for toolbar/compact contexts
Use variant=link for inline text actions
dont: Never place more than one primary button per view
Do not pass label text as the title input
Do not use for toggle states — use DsChipComponent or DsSwitchComponent instead
Do not bind (click) output — it does not exist; use native (click) on the host

components.name: DsInputComponent
components.intent: Single-line text field with label, hint, error, prefix, and icon support. Fully integrated with Angular reactive forms.
components.notes: Implements ControlValueAccessor — works with FormControl/FormGroup. Detects required validator automatically from FormControl. Student theme adds border-[4px] border-b-[8px]. Use inputValue for non-form standalone usage.
components.mobileBehavior: iOS focus handled separately to avoid keyboard jump
do: Wire to FormControl via [formControl] or formControlName
Set errorMessage when showing validation errors outside form
Use iconEnd with (iconEndClick) to build password-visibility toggles
Use inputMode=numeric for digit-only fields on mobile
dont: Do not duplicate errorMessage and form validator — they are both shown
Do not set disabled=true alongside formControl; use formControl.disable() instead

components.name: DsSelectComponent
components.intent: Dropdown/modal select for single or multi-option selection, with optional search, chips, and async loading.
components.notes: On mobile (isMobile=true) the dropdown opens as an IonModal instead of a CDK overlay. Uses DsSelectContextService internally. Multi-select shows chips beneath the input; cap to 2 visible chips with +N badge.
components.mobileBehavior: Opens as full IonModal bottom sheet instead of CDK overlay
do: Pass the full config object as [config]
Use loadOptions for server-side paginated options
Use isMultiple=true + chips=true for tag-style multi-select
dont: Do not mutate config.options in-place — pass a new array reference to trigger re-render
Do not use for boolean toggles — use DsSwitchComponent
alternatives: DsChipComponent / DsChipSelectorComponent for inline chip selection

components.name: DsCheckboxComponent
components.intent: Single checkbox with label, helper text, determinate/indeterminate state, and form integration.
components.notes: Implements ControlValueAccessor and NG_VALIDATORS. Student theme adds border-[4px] border-b-[8px] matching input stroke. Use variantInput=indeterminate for select-all parent checkboxes.
do: Use DsCheckboxGroupComponent when rendering a list of related checkboxes
Set variantInput=indeterminate when partially selected (parent of a list)
Bind to FormControl for form integration
dont: Do not use for mutually exclusive options — use radio buttons instead
alternatives: DsSwitchComponent for a single boolean toggle

components.name: DsModalComponent
components.intent: Scrollable modal body with optional typed header and footer. Used as inner content inside an IonModal.
components.notes: ds-modal is the inner layout wrapper; it must be placed inside an IonModal. Use scrollableContent=true for long-form content to enable scroll within safe area. Use headerComponent to inject a custom header component dynamically.
components.mobileBehavior: IonModal on mobile uses sheet breakpoints; ds-modal handles safe area insets via respectTopSafeArea
do: Always provide dismissFn so footer close/cancel buttons work
Use scrollableContent=true for forms or long content
Use headerConfig for simple title+close pattern
Use headerComponent for complex custom headers
dont: Do not nest ds-modal inside ds-modal
Do not manually scroll the outer IonModal — set scrollY=false on IonModal and let ds-modal handle scrolling
alternatives: DsSidebarComponent for persistent side-panel layout (same API)

components.name: DsChipComponent
components.intent: Compact label/badge element used for filters, tags, status indicators, and removable selections.
components.notes: When static=true, hover effects are disabled (useful for read-only tags). When removable=true, shows an X button and emits (remove). The variant can also be an arbitrary string for custom color classes via customClasses.
do: Use displayType=card for larger chip cards with more padding
Use removable=true + (remove) for tag deletion
Use variant=primary for selected filter state
dont: Do not use chips as primary CTAs — use DsButtonComponent
Do not place interactive chips inside disabled containers without also setting static=true
alternatives: DsButtonComponent variant=secondary for larger toggle buttons
DsChipSelectorComponent for a managed list of selectable chips

components.name: DsTabsComponent
components.intent: Horizontal tab bar for switching between views, with overflow scroll, navigation arrows, badge counts, and RTL support.
components.notes: Requires DS_TRANSLATION_TOKEN to be provided in the module/component injector for label translation via DsTranslatePipe. scrollable=auto (default) auto-detects overflow. Emits the tab id (not the Tab object) on tabChange.
components.mobileBehavior: Navigation arrows hidden on mobile; swipe gesture supported via DsTabsWithSwipeComponent
components.rtlNotes: Scroll direction and arrow icons are RTL-aware
do: Provide DS_TRANSLATION_TOKEN in the host component/module
Use activeTabId to control the active tab from the parent
Use DsTabsWithSwipeComponent on mobile for swipe navigation
dont: Do not forget DS_TRANSLATION_TOKEN — labels will not render correctly without it
Do not use tabs for navigation between routes — use router links
alternatives: DsSegmentedControlComponent for 2-3 options in a compact pill style

components.name: AvatarComponent
components.intent: User avatar displaying a profile image or generated initials with color coding.
components.notes: fullName is required. If imageUrl is provided and valid, the image is displayed; otherwise the first character of fullName is shown as an initial. Color maps to UserProfileColors enum values.
do: Always provide fullName even when imageUrl is set (fallback for broken images)
Use size=md as the default
Use size=2xl or larger for profile/settings pages
dont: Do not pass null as fullName — the component will display an empty circle

components.name: DsIconComponent
components.intent: Unified icon renderer supporting FontAwesome icon definitions, ng-icons string names, and SVG asset paths.
components.notes: Accepts three icon types: (1) FontAwesome IconDefinition objects imported from @fortawesome packages, (2) string names for ng-icons, (3) string paths ending in .svg for Ionic IonIcon SVG assets. Type is auto-detected.
do: Import FA icons as objects: import { faUser } from '@fortawesome/pro-regular-svg-icons'
Pass numeric pixel values for custom sizes: [size]="20"
Use cssClass for color: cssClass="text-brand"
dont: Do not pass FA icon names as strings — pass the imported icon definition object
Do not mix icon libraries in the same icon slot

components.name: DsProgressBarComponent
components.intent: Animated horizontal progress bar with color variants and optional percentage label.
components.notes: Progress value is clamped to 0-100. The bar animates smoothly using requestAnimationFrame with an ease-out cubic curve over 800ms. RTL-aware fill direction.
do: Pass progress as a number 0-100
Use variant=green for positive/completion metrics
Use variant=red for error or critical states
dont: Do not pass values outside 0-100 — they are clamped automatically

components.name: DsSwitchComponent
components.intent: Toggle switch for boolean on/off state or two-way labeled option selection.
components.notes: Implements ControlValueAccessor. type=boolean is a simple on/off toggle. type=two-way shows two labeled options side by side. Use onColor/offColor with CSS variable or hex values.
do: Use type=boolean (default) for simple on/off toggles
Bind to FormControl for reactive forms
Use type=two-way for labeled binary choices like Active/Inactive
dont: Do not use for multi-option selection — use DsSelectComponent or DsRadioGroupComponent

components.name: DsTextareaComponent
components.intent: Multi-line text input with label, hints, character count, and form integration.
components.notes: Implements ControlValueAccessor and NG_VALIDATORS. rows and maxLength use legacy @Input decorator (not signal input). Student theme adds border-[4px] border-b-[8px] matching DsInputComponent.
do: Set rows to control visible height
Enable showCharacterCount=true when maxLength is set
Use hintLeft for helper text and hintRight for character count label
dont: Do not use for single-line text — use DsInputComponent

components.name: DsSidebarComponent
components.intent: Persistent side-panel layout with optional typed header and footer. Shares the same API as DsModalComponent.
components.notes: Structurally identical to DsModalComponent. scrollableContent defaults to true (unlike modal which defaults to false). fullWidthButtons defaults to true in footer. Used inside Ionic split-pane or custom side-panel containers.
components.mobileBehavior: On mobile, sidebars are typically shown as a modal/sheet instead
do: Use scrollableContent=true (default) for sidebars with forms
Provide dismissFn for the close/cancel button to work
dont: Do not use as a floating popover — use DsMenuComponent for that
alternatives: DsModalComponent for the same layout inside a modal dialog

components.name: DsAccordionComponent
components.intent: Collapsible section with title, subtitle, tags, optional icon, and context menu.
components.notes: Content is projected via ng-content. Action buttons can be projected via #accordionActions template. The expanded input is one-way — internal state is managed by isExpanded signal. Call toggle(), expand(), or collapse() programmatically.
do: Use DsAccordionGroupComponent to manage a list of accordions
Use menuItems to add a context menu to the accordion header
Use tags[] for status chips in the header
dont: Do not two-way bind expanded — the input is one-way; listen to (expandedChange) instead
alternatives: DsExpandableComponent for simpler expand/collapse without header structure

components.name: SearchBoxComponent
components.intent: Search input with 300ms debounce, optional add button, cancel button, and bottom-bar visibility management.
components.notes: Emits searchChange after 300ms debounce and distinctUntilChanged. When manageBottomBarVisibility=true (default), the mobile bottom navigation bar is hidden on focus. For use inside modals, set autoFocusDelay=300-400.
components.mobileBehavior: Hides bottom navigation bar on focus via LayoutService
do: Bind [value] to keep the search box in sync with external state
Set autoFocusDelay=350 when placing inside a modal
dont: Do not use inside a form as a form control — it is uncontrolled and emits via (searchChange)
alternatives: DsInputComponent with iconStart=faSearch for a minimal search field without debounce

components.name: DsIconContainerComponent
components.intent: Composite display element that combines an icon with an optional chip badge, context menu, label, and activity indicator.

configShape.label: string
configShape.hasIndicator: boolean (activity dot, mutually exclusive with menu)

components.notes: Use createIconContainerConfig() helper for type-safe config construction. hasIndicator and menu are mutually exclusive — hasIndicator takes priority. isGrayed sets the icon to text-icon-low regardless of iconColorClass.
do: Use createIconContainerConfig() for type safety
Use hasIndicator=true for notification/unread dots
Use chip.text for count badges
dont: Do not set both hasIndicator=true and menu.items — menu will be hidden
alternatives: DsIconComponent alone when no chip/menu/label is needed
